verdict.rationale: Superset documents sending diff-line feedback from the PR Code view to a running agent session, which is a direct way to steer an active agent without restarting it. Related evidence shows Superset notifies you when an agent pauses for input and lets you continue automation workspaces interactively. However, steering is only documented through diff-line feedback, not as a general follow-up-prompt mechanism. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose way to send arbitrary follow-up instructions to an active session (UI/CLI/SDK/MCP), detail on how mid-run steering behaves, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: select diff lines, and send feedback to a running or new agent session.
get notified when an agent finishes or pauses for your input.
the output is a live workspace you (or a teammate) can open, review, and continue interactively.
